run_generate_executables: run the script to generate bash wrapper executables for Spot robot commands in the current conda environment
review_orig_to_alias_mapping: review the orig_to_alias dictionary that maps Spot robot module names to their executable aliases
refactor_exe_generation_loop: refactor the executable generation loop to support custom output directories instead of the conda bin path
test_executable_permissions: test that generated executables have correct permissions set via os.chmod with mode 33277
summarize_exe_script: summarize the script that generates bash wrapper scripts invoking spot_wrapper Python modules
